fit: None. Frozen H815 shared/private and uniform flat bases. Dictionary hash checked against pre-native lock.
selection: All31 eligible new prefixed IOI pairs. No fit or outcome-based exclusions; names disjoint from fit panel. Surface differs by fixed prefix.
comparisons: Shared rank r vs specific rank r matches active dimension but specific total storage is2r; shared rank2r vs specific rankr matches total storage. No trained sparse gates, taxonomy, or computational DAG.
group_fit: Compare independent two-rank4, independent two-rank5, and shared PCA2 plus two residual rank3 groups. Five restarts seeds8140-8144 per model, uniform unit-response weights, fit/gate no task labels, training error selection only; same heldout split. Shared block fixed before residual-group fit. Union shared atom contribution counted once.
distribution_metric: KL(full uncompressed intervention output || candidate output), computed in float64 across full vocabulary; full is same source perturbation and input-response arm, not zero/native baseline. Reverse KL and total variation secondary. No heldout gate selection.
ablation_design: Frozen H815 bases and gates; select group from original dx once, then keep both/shared-only/private-only/neither, or substitute the other private block while keeping shared. No gate recomputation after deletion. Compare fidelity with exact uncompressed module response.
primary: Heldout causal response fidelity and context-gap preservation, plus input reconstruction. Full source perturbation/recipient baseline retained.
